### 【Mode】Text-to-Video

### 【Output Specifications】
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Resolution: 1440p

### 【Overall Setting】
Generate a 10-second 16:9 cinematic video in a cyberpunk style. The overall atmosphere is cold, melancholic, and poetic, depicting a cybernetic repair technician in a moment of contemplation beside a parked vintage aircraft on a rainy night. The lighting emphasizes cool-toned neon blues and purples, contrasted with warm amber light from the cockpit.

### 【Timeline Visual Description】
[0s-3s]： Wide shot. A vintage-style aircraft with sleek but weathered lines is vertically parked on a landing platform atop a high-rise building. Rain runs down its fuselage, which bears worn paint and scorch marks. The camera performs a slow orbital tracking movement from the front-left side to the right, gradually revealing the silhouette of a technician standing at the platform's edge with her back to the camera. Environmental lighting comes from distant city billboards in cool blue and magenta, while a faint warm amber glow emanates from the cockpit.

[3s-7s]： Medium shot. The technician stands in profile, clad in a black waterproof oilskin trench coat. Her right arm is an exposed metallic prosthetic with subtle blue LED indicators pulsing at the joints. She slowly lifts her face to the rain, gazing at the towering skyscrapers in the distance. The camera slowly pushes in on her, transitioning from a wide shot to a knee-level medium close-up. Lighting comes from two sources—warm amber on the right side of her face and cool blue on the left—accentuating the contrast between the cold metal prosthetic and the warmth of her skin.

[7s-10s]： Close-up. Focus on the technician's face and right shoulder prosthetic. She slightly lowers her head, and her metallic fingers gently touch an interface port at the back of her neck, emitting a faint blue pulse of light. She then lowers her hand and takes a deep breath; the exhaled vapor dissipates instantly in the cold rain. The camera holds steady on this close-up, with shallow depth of field blurring the background city neon into soft bokeh. Colors gradually shift toward cool blue, and the lighting dims, ultimately fading to darkness in a blue pulse.

### 【Audio Description】
[0s-3s]： Distant, continuous low-frequency city drone. Dense, crisp rain sounds striking metal surfaces. An ethereal synth pad slowly swells, creating a sense of detachment and solitude.

[3s-7s]： Rain persists. At 3 seconds, a deep, resonant industrial ambient tone (resembling metallic resonance) enters. At 5 seconds, a faint, rhythmic electronic kick drum begins to emerge, intertwining with the sound of rain.

[7s-10s]： At 7 seconds, a crisp, high-frequency electronic notification tone accompanies the prosthetic's activation. The bass elements in the music gradually recede, allowing rain and wind to reclaim the soundscape. During the final second, all sounds gently fade, concluding with the ambient hum of dissipating rain and environmental noise.

### 【On-Screen Text】
None

### 【Visual Constraints】
Cinematic, photorealistic style with 8K ultra-high definition. Shallow depth of field, subtle film grain texture. Smooth, stable camera movement—no shaking, no cuts (single continuous take throughout). Character facial features and clothing remain consistent. No new characters or objects are introduced. No distortion of scene structure. No garbled text or incorrect text rendering.
